verdict.rationale: A community report confirms Gemini 3 Pro is available through OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/google/gemini-3-pro-preview) as an alternative to Google's own endpoint. It notes added latency and lower reliability as tradeoffs. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint is still Google's own API, so it does not count as a third-party channel. missing for 10: first-party documentation of multi-channel availability, evidence of Vertex AI access to the same models, any Bedrock or Azure availability, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond a single forum comment.
